reviews.comment:
el 16 de febrero a las 13 hrs pare a cargar nafta me pasaron la tarjeta de debito varias veces y luego de bastante tiempo me dijeron que no habia sistema y me cobraron efectivo, luego al mirar los movimientos en el banco, me lo habian cobrado con débito, o sea me cobraron 2 veces

(Translated by Google)
On February 16th at 1 PM I stopped to get gas. They swiped my debit card several times and after a long time they told me the system was down and charged me in cash. Then, when I checked my bank statements, I saw they had charged me with my debit card, meaning I was charged twice.
